newsitem.title: USA: Fleming Cos Q1 shr $0.14 vs $0.16.
newsitem.headline: Fleming Cos Q1 shr $0.14 vs $0.16.

text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers)

Note: The company reported adjusted earnings to $14.3 million, or $0.38 per share, for the first quarter of 1997, compared to $9.4 million, or $0.25 per share for the same period a year ag The company said an adjustment of $19.2 million was recored in the first quarrter this year for the David's settlement.
The company's 1996 litigation charge was reversed in the second quarter of 1996 and a new charge of $650 was recorded.
The company's operating earnings for the quarter was $26 million, compared to $15 million for the same period a year ago.
Analyst consensus for the quarter was $0.27 per share, according to First Call.
The company's 16 week quarters ended April 19, 1997 and April 20, 1996.
